description: Called when the Library needs to know which admin permission guards an add-on's logs. Set $permissionId to that permission. Admins then need it as well as "View addon logs". Leave it unset to require "View addon logs" only.

arguments.name: $addonId
arguments.description: the add-on whose logs are being checked

arguments.name: &$permissionId
arguments.description: the admin permission ID that guards this add-on's logs
